items.title: Publicis Sapient CTO on What Companies Should Do After Tokenmaxxing
items.summary: Tokenmaxxing has put the AI bill on the CFO's desk. Publicis Sapient's CTO explains what companies should measure after the usage leaderboard. In this exclusive Front Page interview, Sudhi Sachdev of AIM speaks with Rakesh Ravuri, CTO - SVP Engineering at Publicis Sapient, whose firm's July paper gave tokenmaxxing its name. Expect a clear look at why companies created AI leaderboards, how to spend tokens where they create value, what CFOs and CTOs should own, and what a European bank changed beyond software.
